_meta.note: Captured by scripts/capture_muse_frames.py off the fork adapter dist/index.js driven over stdio against Muse Code 1.4.11 (MUSE_CODE_EXECUTABLE=host muse), a signed-in account, so the model answered live. Agent-to-client lines in order. Crew's FULL two-part seed was sent, imported from the harness module: initialize clientCapabilities._meta[muse/approval]=1, and session/new _meta[muse/approval]={"policy": "promptUnmatched", "profile": ":ask-me"}. The builtin shell turn, ALLOW path (allow_once). The sandboxed first attempt fails and the model retries with escalated sandbox, which draws a session/request_permission; answering allow_once runs it to a completed tool_call_update with the command's output. All seven required classes. Reductions: 6 available_commands_update/session_info_update/config_option_update frame(s) dropped: host command/skill inventory, host-compatibility fingerprints and the provider/model catalog -- recording-host data, not a required class; 12 host reminderChild tool-call frame(s) dropped: the host's own internal churn, not the probe's call; the session id is replaced with the synthetic muse-session-1; every host-minted uuid (museApprovalId/museTurnId/museItemId/...) is replaced with a fixed synthetic muse-id-N; every call_<hex> tool-call id is replaced with a synthetic muse-call-N. The ids are synthetic; nothing else is altered.
